metadata.title: An explicit Frobenius corollary of established marginal entropy bounds for permanents
metadata.description: Self-contained, credited corollary of Anari-Rezaei marginal entropy bounds, also implied by Anari (2026) and Dong-Jain (2026). For nonnegative row-stochastic A of order n>=1 and S=sum a_ij^2, per(A)<=exp(-n+e^4 S(1+log n)). Historical novelty and priority remain UNKNOWN. Extensive AI assistance; unrefereed; no external human peer review or formal proof-assistant certification.
